result.title: Power Setpoint Tracking for Large-Scale EV Charging: Transformer-Constrained Charging Policy Learning with Self-Tuning Constraint Prices
result.comment: 13 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Transportation Electrification
result.summary: In power setpoint tracking (PST), an operator follows a purchased charging profile without overloading shared transformers or undercharging vehicles. PST is cast as a constrained Markov decision process that minimizes tracking error subject to overload and mean user-satisfaction constraints. Transformer-Constrained Charging Policy Learning (TC-CPL) extends soft actor-critic with proportional-integral Lagrange-multiplier updates from measured violations, a residual on the incumbent dispatcher that is warm-started from its demonstrations, and a transformer-aware encoder shared by all ports. It observes no departure times or states of charge. Simulations (five seeds, 100 paired days) compare it with the incumbent, Round-Robin. On a 600-port, 122-substation district, raw overload falls from 3.59 to 0.0017 kWh/day (overloaded seed-days from 77% to 0.4%), and absolute tracking error falls by 27%. Delivered energy rises by 16%, and satisfaction rises from 0.959 to 0.989. On a 42-kW transformer with household load, overload falls from 1.86 to 0.0014 kWh/day and satisfaction rises from 0.974 to 0.985, but absolute tracking error is 22% higher. Against hand-set fixed multipliers, self-tuning is statistically indistinguishable on the district. On the single transformer, it raises satisfaction by 0.011 at similar overload, but a short sweep found a better-serving fixed pair. The overload multipliers stay below their cap.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文把大规模电动汽车充电的功率设定点跟踪建模为带过载与用户满意度约束的约束 MDP，用扩展 soft actor-critic、比例积分式拉格朗日乘子自适应与基于既有调度器示范的残差策略进行学习。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于电力系统调度控制工作，无视觉或多模态输入，也无 latent 推理状态、证据获取与停止决策等联系；其中的约束乘子自适应与残差策略虽属通用 RL 技巧，但材料未给出可用于 LVR 的具体借鉴线索，故排除。
